notes:
uEmAngeloWeapon is a REAL nested class (SE uEmAngelo::uEmAngeloWeapon, own DTI 0xE595B8, getDTI 0x726CB0); 0xBD8B08 is correctly its vtable (77 slots, uActor-based). The actual uEmAngelo vtable is 0xBD8950 (109 slots = uEnemy 103 + 6: setPlayerHoming, setEffectFromMotSeq, initEffect, updatePtrEffect, resetEffect, resetEffectKill), now labelled uEmAngelo::vftable.
Mislabelled vtables fixed: 0xBCB888 (was uEm005::vftable) is uEm005::uEm005Shield::vftable; real uEm005::vftable is 0xBCB6A8 (118 slots). 0xBD3EFC (was uEm022::vftable) is the 5-slot uEmAngelo::cComboCtrl vtable; real uEm022::vftable is 0xBD3F18 (110 slots). The vt[] fields in dx9_uem_features.json for uEm005/uEm022 were therefore built from the wrong vtables.
Hierarchy confirmed: uEmAngelo -> uEm005 -> uEm006 (uEm006 vtable shares uEm005 slots); uEmAngelo -> uEm022.
The SE->DX9 slot map for the enemy chain agrees with group C: 0->0, 1->1, 3->3, 4->4, 5->5, 9(moveEx)->7, 11(sync)->8, 12(draw)->9, 21(kill)->12, 40->20, 41->21, 50(updateMaterial)->29, 53(main)->30, 54(updatePtr)->31, 57->34, 59(damageMessage)->36, 60->37, 63->40, 67->44, 68->45, 70->47, 71->48, 72->49, 73->50, 81->55, 83->57, 84->58, 92->66, 98->72, 101->74, 114->77, 116->79, 125->87, 126->88, 144..149->103..108. DX9 uEnemy::die (slot 12) is SE kill, and uEnemy::validateTargetPtrs (slot 31) is SE updatePtr. Decompiling 0x572C70/0x6B6510 (both test +0xEA8 & 0x10) and 0x572270/0x6B58D0 (both test +0x3F8 & 0x200) confirmed the injureMessage/enemyJumpMessage slot pairing.
DX9 has new virtuals that SE lacks: uEm005 slot 110 and uEm022 slot 109 are setMotion, with identical motion-ID immediates. SE instead overrides uModel::setMotion at SE slot 35. These SE virtuals have no DX9 vtable counterpart: uEm005::setDeltaTimeRate(float,int), isAir, isEnableDamageInvCalc, isHighTimeDamage, convertSSwordConstBone, reverseMessage (a 3-byte ret, folded into nullsub), and uEm022::addEnemyDieCnt, isEnableDamageInvCalc.
0x7271C0 (was uEm023::newInstance) is uEmAngelo::setEffectFromMotSeq: uEmAngelo slot 104 / SE slot 145, nbb 64/64, and it reads the motseq flag word at +0x3F8 bit 30. It is NOT initEffect. initEffect is slot 105 = 0x5613C0 (21 bytes, same size as SE).
COMDAT folding in DX9: uEm005/uEm022 damageCalcFinishMessage -> 0x572C50, setDevilTriggerSign -> 0x5720E0, isMotionEnd -> 0x6AB840. Each is named after the class that owns the code region, with an 'also SE:' comment for the other. The shell draw overrides fold into the out-of-region 5-byte stub 0x560290, which is recorded but not renamed. uEm022 dmgInterruptS/dmgAbdominal, dmgBlown/dmgAirBlown and uEm006 atkExc2End/atkExc3End also look folded (medium, comment only).
SE-only functions: 7 MT allocator stubs per class (usage/operator new/delete) that DX9 does not have, and many tiny set*() action setters (18-28 bytes) that DX9 inlines into setAction. Ctors and dtors inline differently: the uEm006 ctor is inlined into MyDTI::newInstance 0x576C80, and ~uEm005GenkiShl/~uEm006/~uEm006Coop/~uEm022/~uEm022EngelShl/~uEm022JavelinShl are inlined into the deleting dtors.
20 deleting-dtor and MyDTI::newInstance stubs in these regions were undefined code (not functions). They were defined and named; deleting dtors are named Class::scalar_deleting_dtor / vector_deleting_dtor.
The inline uEmAngelo virtuals (copyTUsrParam, initEffect, updatePtrEffect, resetEffectKill) are emitted at 0x561380-0x5614A0 at the head of the uEm005 TU, not in the uEmAngelo TU (0x726CA0-0x728290).
TU order: DX9 keeps set*/action pairs adjacent, while SE groups set* first. Motion-ID immediates agree in 315 of 333 matched pairs where both sides carry immediates; the 18 disagreements are struct-offset/alloc-size immediates that differ between engines.
Not renamed: 0x577820 uEm006::validateTargetPtrs is kept as a conflict (deliberate name; SE updatePtr). The DTI global 0xE59138 is still named uEm022::cComboCtrl::DTI, while SE calls the class uEmAngelo::cComboCtrl; only its getDTI 0x6AA0B0 was renamed to uEmAngelo::cComboCtrl::getDTI.
Not renamed, shared out-of-region stubs: 0x560290 (shell draw), 0x62D4A0/0x618400 (uEm005 applyIceMaterial/transFreeze, 5-byte stubs), 0x455B10 (cComboCtrl dtor slot).
